answer: An agent economy can make Sybil identities costly by requiring each account to lock a scarce token before it can submit work, with rewards and voting power capped by the amount and duration of the stake. A newcomer may sound as clear as crystal or describe a lagoon beside a river, but that does not create extra stake. To multiply influence, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, paying an opportunity cost and risking slashing if accounts coordinate fraudulently.
